Yes — **Wiggle & Snug Member Rewards is still available**. The current Member Rewards page says it’s **free to join**, members earn points on every order, and it lists two tiers. ([trueshopstore.com](https://trueshopstore.com/loyalty))

The tiers are:

1. **Member** — free to join; earns **1 point per $1 spent** and gets members-only offers.  
2. **Member+** — requires **$150+ spend per year**; earns **1 point per $1 spent**, plus **5% off select categories** and member pricing on selected products. ([trueshopstore.com](https://trueshopstore.com/loyalty))
